description: Melbourne Wastewater Treatment (East) - Daily Grid Electricity Consumption is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Daily accumulated electricity supply (kWh) and daily accumulated electricity generation (kWh) into the Eastern Treatment Plant (ETP) of Melbourne Water. This data is collected using revenue quality meters across each supply line (feeder) into the plant, and Melbourne Water owned power meters for generation measurements. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Its tags are open-data. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
